.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/HasseDeriv.lean:16:# Hasse derivative of polynomials
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/HasseDeriv.lean:18:The `k`th Hasse derivative of a polynomial `∑ a_i X^i` is `∑ (i.choose k) a_i X^(i-k)`.
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/HasseDeriv.lean:19:It is a variant of the usual derivative, and satisfies `k! * (hasseDeriv k f) = derivative^[k] f`.
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/HasseDeriv.lean:25:In the following, we write `D k` for the `k`-th Hasse derivative `hasse_deriv k`.
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/HasseDeriv.lean:27:* `Polynomial.hasseDeriv`: the `k`-th Hasse derivative of a polynomial
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/HasseDeriv.lean:28:* `Polynomial.hasseDeriv_zero`: the `0`th Hasse derivative is the identity
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/HasseDeriv.lean:29:* `Polynomial.hasseDeriv_one`: the `1`st Hasse derivative is the usual derivative
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/HasseDeriv.lean:30:* `Polynomial.factorial_smul_hasseDeriv`: the identity `k! • (D k f) = derivative^[k] f`
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/HasseDeriv.lean:31:* `Polynomial.hasseDeriv_comp`: the identity `(D k).comp (D l) = (k+l).choose k • D (k+l)`
